fields.description: When checked, each import run that adds new candidate names automatically enqueues a classification run. Explicit backfills (bench execute) always work regardless of this flag.
fields.label: Auto Classify After Import

fields.description: Passed to the claude CLI as --model. Uses your Claude Code subscription; haiku conserves usage quota.
fields.label: Classification Model

fields.description: Candidate names per claude CLI call.
fields.label: Classification Chunk Size

fields.description: Full path to the claude binary. If this isn't a real file (e.g. left as the bare default and claude isn't on the worker's PATH), the bundled Claude Code VS Code extension binary is auto-detected — no separate install needed.
fields.label: Claude CLI Path

fields.description: Full path to a second CLI (e.g. Codex) used automatically for a chunk when claude fails or hits its subscription session limit. Leave blank to auto-detect a local Codex install (checks PATH, then the Codex.app bundle on macOS); leave both blank and undetectable to disable the fallback.
fields.label: Fallback CLI Path

fields.description: Model passed to the fallback CLI. Leave blank to use that CLI's own configured default model.
fields.label: Fallback Model

fields.description: A 'person' verdict at or above this confidence auto-confirms the name (personalization only — the outreach recipient is never redirected to a guessed address automatically).
fields.label: Min Auto-Confirm Confidence

fields.description: A 'not_person' verdict at or above this confidence auto-rejects the row from review. Anything between the thresholds goes to Needs Review.
fields.label: Min Auto-Reject Confidence

fields.description: A candidate name appearing on at least this many distinct Company Profiles is treated as boilerplate marketing copy and auto-rejected without an LLM call.
fields.label: Recurrence Blacklist Threshold

fields.description: When checked, a classification run that produces new Auto Confirmed candidates automatically enqueues an email verification run. Explicit backfills (bench execute) always work regardless of this flag.
fields.label: Auto Verify After Classification

fields.description: API key for the MillionVerifier real-time verification API (https://app.millionverifier.com/api). Pay-as-you-go, credits never expire.
fields.label: Email Verification API Key

fields.description: Seconds MillionVerifier is given to resolve a single address (its documented max is 60).
fields.label: Email Verification Timeout (seconds)

fields.description: Candidate rows verified before each progress commit. Each row may cost up to 6 API calls (guessed_email_1-6, stopping at the first deliverable result).
fields.label: Email Verification Chunk Size
